title: 第93章 做大做强再创辉煌第92章 九进十三出有搞头
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
姜芷柔目光灼灼看向姬飞雪，传音道：“飞雪婆婆，挣灵石的事带上我啊。”
姬飞雪收到姜芷柔的传音，回道：“前些天不是还不情愿呢，现在叫得这么甜，无事献殷勤，非奸即盗。”
姜芷柔回道：“你等着婆媳反目成仇吧。”
姬飞雪也回道：“注意你的态度，你求人就是这个态度？”
姜芷柔马上回道：“好婆婆，帮帮我呗，这营生好赚啊，带我玩，保证让你不后悔！”
姬飞雪又回道：“我想要几个孙子，你生的娃绝对漂亮！”
姜芷柔俏脸微红，回道：“那都不是事，你先帮我，我多生几个给你玩。”
姬飞雪微微一笑。说道：“天儿，我看这生意啊，你要不带上妘家和姜家，妘裳和妘依是我们姬家的人，姜家族长都嫁过来了。带上他们，也是一个助力。”
姬云天听到姬飞雪的话，心中有些惊异，他非常了解姬飞雪的秉性，当了几千年族长，没见过什么大钱，她这样说，让姬云天不得不认真考虑一番了。
姬云天沉吟道：“母亲，带上妘家和姜家，倒也没什么，可是我们一不缺资源，二不缺人，他们两家进来纯分账，不太好吧。”
姬飞雪笑道：“怎么办，你自己看，反正我的意见就是带上她们两家，三家一起不是更好？”
这话一下就提醒到姬云天了，还真是好事，三家可以在四域展开，现在一次谈到位，确实要比之后慢慢跟其他八大族成员谈更好。
姬云天忙道：“母亲说的是，带上其他两家吧，我们一起，做大做强，再创辉煌！”
姬飞雪补充道：“只是得定好规矩，各人额度的利息、还款期限都得写死，还要防着有人串通担保人骗贷，得专门设个管事的部门盯着才行”。姬云天笑着点头，本来就是要借着蓝星七组的人手来操办这事，当下就把章程定了下来。
老毕登提出了搞果果贷，被姬云天否了，这个世界可是能重塑造肉身的，形象是可以变化的，要是修士贷出一大笔，直接搞个重塑肉身，改变形象，那可真的可以脱胎换骨的了。到时果果贷有毛线用。
本来，姬云天想在苍玄域搞试点，跑顺了再往其他几域铺开，现在既然要带着妘家和姜家玩，那就要换换办法了。
可是妘峥和姜芷柔都提出不想让家族参与到这里，他们想的是由自己这一脉参与，姬云天当即决定，首先在苍天城搞个合股总部，姬家占股70%，拥有绝对控股权，妘峥和姜芷柔他们这一脉，由二人代表，妘峥占股20，姜芷柔占10%，而妘家与姜家苍山域和苍澜域的生意，仿照百花楼模式，由这个总部与各家签订协议。这个方案一出，姜芷柔脸色有些不好看。
姬云天道：“妘家与姬家向来交好，多一些也无可厚非。”
但一边的姜芷柔却已经和姬飞雪传音打上嘴仗了，：“给妘裳家那么多，可不能厚此薄彼啊。”
姬飞雪回道：“妘裳来得早，还给我生了大胖孙子，你刚来就要平起平坐，你是不是有点过分了啊。”

姜芷柔回道：“生孩子我能不会？姬家要是这样，那我就绝育了，我天天和你打架，你等着吧，让苍天大世界都好好看看，婆媳大战的好戏是不会断的！”
姬飞雪道：“你再威胁我一个试试？”
姜芷柔立即道：“哎呀，好婆婆，你帮我，我给你生孙子，你要多少我生多少，听你话还不打你。”
姬飞雪心中呵呵笑，她这么多年总是被妘裳和姜芷柔这俩好闺蜜磋磨，现在总算扬眉吐气了。
姬飞雪道：“天儿，不如两家一样吧，也显得我们姬家一碗水端平。”
姬云天心中一笑，郑色道：“那就听你的吧。”此事算是定下了。
姜芷柔脸上一喜，却在这时，姬飞雪的声音传来：“今天我要看着你俩洞房，别以为我不知道，你推推搡搡快半个月了，你要是今天不好好表现，明天我就让天儿把协议改了，让你哭去。”
姜芷柔的俏脸僵了一下，心道：“这是躲不过去了吗？”
无奈传音道：“你有心吗，你还看自己儿子行房，你要点脸吧！”
姬飞雪回道：“我喜欢看，今天看不到，明天协议就得改。”
姜芷柔咬牙道：“好好好，让你看，让你眼睛长针眼。”
姬飞雪回道：“看针眼我也要看，我还要给我儿子喊加油呢。”
姜芷柔气得够呛，看了姬飞雪一眼，不说话了。
看到姜芷柔的样子，姬飞雪知道，她胜利了。得意地笑了笑。
短短半个月，“苍天银号”就在苍天城挂起了招牌，随后就是苍山城和苍澜城，加上姬家苍玄城，八大族九大域，就有三族四域开始营业，很显然，这速度比当时的百花楼要强不少。
修仙贷刚一推出，就引得无数中小修士蜂拥而至，毕竟不是谁都能像大家族一样坐拥无穷资源，不少卡在瓶颈的修士缺那么一两件宝贝，缺那么一笔灵石，有了修仙贷，正好解了燃眉之急，银号开业第一天就放出去近百亿极品灵石的贷，银号的管事笑着把账册报给姬云天时，姬云天只笑着说了句，慢慢来，往后这苍天大世界的流通，就得是我们苍天银号了。
开业没几天，意外的惊喜就到了，姚家和夏侯家的姚威东和夏候伯先后到了苍天城的苍天银号，要求抵押贷。
这两大族是真的没办法了，当姚威东和夏侯伯回到苍南域时，才发现整个域都被姬家刮了一遍，除天苍南域的天法城和天妖域的天车城资源还算够用，可这两城现在已经归姬家了，他们想用资源也不能号令这两城了。
想要重建两族，就得投入不少资源，可是他们的府库都已经见底了，无奈之下，听说苍天银号放贷，他二人这才动了心思，两家有城，有地，有矿脉，也算可抵押之物，就前后脚来抵押贷款来了。
content_en:
Jiang Zhirou looked at Ji Feixue with burning eyes and said through a message: "Grandma Feixue, take me with you to earn spiritual stones."
Ji Feixue received the message from Jiang Zhirou and replied: "Isn't it true that I was reluctant a few days ago? Now I am screaming so sweetly. I am showing courtesy for nothing. I am either raping or stealing."
Jiang Zhirou replied: "Just wait until your mother-in-law and daughter-in-law turn against each other."
Ji Feixue also replied: "Pay attention to your attitude. Is this your attitude when asking for help?"
Jiang Zhirou immediately replied: "Good mother-in-law, please help me. This business is very profitable. Let me play with you. I guarantee you won't regret it!"
Ji Feixue replied: "I want some grandchildren, and the baby you gave birth to will be absolutely beautiful!"
Jiang Zhirou's pretty face turned red and she replied: "That's not a big deal. You help me first, and I'll give birth to a few more for you to play with."
Ji Feixue smiled slightly. He said: "Tian'er, I think this business is going to work. Why don't you bring the Yu family and the Jiang family? Yu Shang and Yu Yi are from our Ji family, and the head of the Jiang family is married. Bringing them will also be a help."
Ji Yuntian was a little surprised when he heard Ji Feixue's words. He knew Ji Feixue's character very well. He had been a clan leader for thousands of years and had never seen much money. What she said made Ji Yuntian have to think about it seriously.
Ji Yuntian muttered: "Mom, it's okay to bring the Yu family and the Jiang family, but we don't lack resources and people. It's not good for them to come in and just divide the accounts."
Ji Feixue smiled and said: "What to do, you can see for yourself. Anyway, my opinion is to bring two of them together. Wouldn't it be better for the three of them to go together?"
These words immediately reminded Ji Yuntian. It was really a good thing. The three families could expand in the four domains. Talking about it now would be better than slowly talking to members of the other eight major clans later.
Ji Yuntian said hurriedly: "What mother said is, bring the other two families with you. Together, we can become bigger and stronger and create greater glory!"
Ji Feixue added: "It's just that we have to set good rules. The interest and repayment period of each person's limit must be written down. We also have to prevent someone from colluding with the guarantor to cheat the loan. We have to set up a special department to keep an eye on it." Ji Yuntian smiled and nodded. He originally wanted to use the personnel of Blue Star Group 7 to handle this matter, so he immediately decided on the regulations.
Old Biden proposed a Guoguo loan, but Ji Yuntian rejected it. This world can reshape the body, and the image can be changed. If the monk lends a large sum of money to directly reshape the body and change the image, it can really be reborn. When the time comes, Guoguolai will have wool to use.
Originally, Ji Yuntian wanted to conduct a pilot project in the Cangxuan Domain and then spread it to other domains if it went well. Now that he wanted to play with the Yu family and the Jiang family, he had to change his approach.
However, both Ruan Zheng and Jiang Zhirou stated that they did not want their families to participate here. They wanted their own family to participate. Ji Yuntian immediately decided to first set up a joint venture headquarters in Cangtian City. The Ji family would hold 70% of the shares and have absolute controlling rights. , Ruan Zheng and Jiang Zhirou are represented by two people. Ruan Zheng holds 20% of the shares and Jiang Zhirou holds 10%. The business between the Yuan family and the Jiang family in the Cangshan and Canglan areas is modeled on the Baihualou model, with this headquarters signing agreements with each company. As soon as this plan came out, Jiang Zhirou looked a little unhappy.
Ji Yuntian said: "The Yu family and the Ji family have always been on good terms, so there is nothing wrong with having more."
But Jiang Zhirou on the other side had already started a verbal spat with Ji Feixue Chuanyin, saying, "I've given so much to the Yushang family, but I can't favor one over the other."
Ji Feixue replied: "Yu Shang came early and gave birth to a big fat grandson for me. You want to treat me as an equal just after you came. Are you going a little too far?"
Jiang Zhirou replied: "Can I have a baby? If the Ji family is like this, then I will be sterilized. I will fight with you every day. Just wait and let the whole world watch. The fun of the battle between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law will never stop!"
Ji Feixue said: "You want to threaten me again?"
Jiang Zhirou immediately said: "Oh, my dear mother-in-law, please help me and I will give you grandchildren. Do you want more?"No matter how many children I have, I will listen to you and not beat you. "
Ji Feixue chuckled in her heart. She had always been rubbed against by her two best friends, Yu Shang and Jiang Zhirou, for so many years, and now she was finally feeling proud.
Ji Feixue said: "Tian'er, it's better for the two families to be the same. It also seems that our Ji family has a bowl of water. "
Ji Yuntian smiled in his heart and said Zheng Se, "Then I'll listen to you. "The matter is finally settled.
Jiang Zhirou's face was filled with joy, but at this moment, Ji Feixue's voice came: "Today I want to watch your wedding, don't think I don't know, you have been pushing and pushing me for almost half a month, if you don't behave well today, I will ask Tian'er to change the agreement tomorrow and let you cry. "
Jiang Zhirou's pretty face froze for a moment, and she thought to herself: "Is it impossible to escape? "
He had no choice but to send a message: "Are you serious? You still want to see your son having sex, so why don't you save some face!" "
Ji Feixue replied: "I like to see it, but if I can't see it today, the agreement will have to be changed tomorrow. "
Jiang Zhirou gritted her teeth and said: "Okay, okay, I'll let you see it, I'll let you have needle holes in your eyes. "
Ji Feixue replied: "I want to see the eye of a needle, and I want to cheer for my son. "
Jiang Zhirou was so angry that she glanced at Ji Feixue and stopped talking.
Seeing Jiang Zhirou's look, Ji Feixue knew that she had won. He smiled smugly.
In just half a month, the "Cangtian Silver" signboard was put up in Cangtian City, followed by Cangshan City and Canglan City, plus Ji Family Cangxuan City, the eight major clans and nine major domains, three clans and four domains began to operate. Obviously, this speed was much faster than Baihua Tower at that time.
As soon as the Immortal Cultivation Loan was launched, it attracted countless small and medium-sized monks to flock to it. After all, not everyone can have unlimited resources like a big family. Many monks who are stuck in the bottleneck lack one or two treasures or a certain amount of spiritual stones. With the Immortal Cultivation Loan, it is just the solution. Out of urgency, the bank issued a loan of nearly tens of billions of top-quality spiritual stones on the first day it opened. When the bank manager smiled and reported the account book to Ji Yuntian, Ji Yuntian just smiled and said, "Take your time. From now on, the circulation in this world will be our Cangtian Bank."
A few days after the opening, an unexpected surprise arrived. Yao Weidong and Xiahou Bo from the Yao family and Xiahou family successively went to the Cangtian Bank in Cangtian City to ask for a mortgage loan.
These two major clans really had no choice. When Yao Weidong and Xia Houbo returned to the Cangnan Territory, they found that the entire territory had been wiped out by the Ji family. Except for Tianfa City in the Cangnan Territory and Tianche City in the Tianyao Territory, the resources were still sufficient. However, these two cities have now belonged to the Ji family, and they could not order these two cities even if they wanted to use the resources.
If they want to rebuild the two clans, they have to invest a lot of resources, but their treasury has already reached the bottom. In desperation, they heard that Cangtian Bank was lending money, and the two of them came up with the idea. The two families had cities, land, and mineral veins, which could be regarded as mortgages, so they came to mortgage the loans.
